scheme_name: Technical Education Scholarship Scheme For Diploma Level
other_conditions: Applicant must be a bonafide Himachali student and a ward of Himachal Pradesh Government employees
Applicant must be pursuing a Diploma level course in Engineering/Technology approved by AICTE
Parents’ or guardians’ total annual income must not exceed ₹36,000
Student must have secured at least 60% marks in the qualifying examination (exempted for SC and ST candidates)
Scholarship is awarded on the basis of poverty‑cum‑brilliance or brilliance, with merit determined by income and academic performance
Renewal requires a recommendation from the principal or authorized institute officer and satisfactory academic progress
Scholarship will be discontinued if the student fails an examination that prevents promotion to the next class
benefits_summary: A monthly scholarship of ₹200 is provided to all diploma students; SC, ST, and girl students receive a full (100%) scholarship.
